Indian captain Smit Machchhar sustained serious injuries but managed to unlock the cockpit door. Passengers intervened and overpowered the co-pilot, ensuring the safety of everyone aboard. The flight was diverted to Saudi Arabia, where all 174 people landed safely. Investigations by authorities from Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Israel are ongoing.

title: Massachusetts couple wins $310,000 judgment in neighbour tree dispute
description: A Massachusetts couple achieved a remarkable win in their legal battle against their neighbor, successfully advocating for themselves in court. They were awarded $310,000 for damages due to tree destruction and unauthorized encroachments. The ruling by the Massachusetts Appeals Court upheld their victory, emphasizing that self-represented individuals can indeed confront intricate legal issues effectively. This judgment concludes a drawn-out conflict over property rights and associated damages.

title: How Maria Sharapova built a $220 million fortune beyond tennis
description: Sharapova used her tennis success to build a bigger business career after retiring. Her estimated $220 million fortune has been tied to career earnings, global endorsements, Sugarpova and investments in consumer, wellness, fitness and technology companies, allowing the five-time Grand Slam champion to build a financial portfolio outside of professional tennis.

title: India World Cup 2027 Match schedule: Full fixture list, dates, venues

title: Tyreek Hill next team: Vikings and Packers emerge as possible landing spots
description: Tyreek Hill has not been signed by any NFL team, largely because of his recovery timeline. Though he seems ready, he recently expressed his desire to join a cold-weather team. This could mean the Minnesota Vikings, as Justin Jefferson is suffering from an ankle injury. It could also be the Green Bay Packers, since Jayden Reed is out for the season.

title: India, Pakistan, Australia in same group for 2027 ODI World Cup
description: India and Pakistan, along with Australia, will be part of Group A in the upcoming 2027 ICC Men's ODI World Cup. The tournament is set to take place in South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia, starting on October 2 and concluding on November 21. A total of 14 teams will participate, divided into two groups of six after a preliminary stage.

title: Govt limits sugar stock limit to 1,000 quintals ahead of festive season
description: The Centre will implement new stock limits for sugar dealers starting October 15 until November 30. The inventory cap has been set at 1,000 quintals with a 15-day holding period. This decision follows a notable decrease in ex-mill sugar prices and aims to control hoarding during the festive season. Kolkata and Assam have been given slightly higher stock limits due to distribution needs.

title: Iran military kills 6 in Zahedan, accuses armed groups of ties with foreign powers
description: Iranian military forces killed six members of a designated terrorist group in Zahedan on Thursday. Clashes between security forces and armed groups frequently occur in Sistan-Baluchistan province, highlighting ongoing regional tensions. The Iranian revolutionary guards reported finding explosive packages with the detained individuals during their operation. Meanwhile, Tehran is contemplating the United States' response to its recent peace proposal for reviving negotiations.

title: ICC ODI World Cup 2027 full schedule: Who plays whom, full fixtures, dates and venues
description: India will begin their ICC ODI World Cup 2027 campaign against Australia on October 7 in Cape Town, after the ICC announced the schedule for the tournament on Thursday. India and Pakistan have been placed in the same Group A, setting up another much-awaited clash between the two teams.

title: Iran summons UK envoy after PM Burnham hints Tehran link in Fairford 'terror plot'
description: Iran's foreign ministry expressed its discontent by summoning the British ambassador, following remarks made by UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham about Tehran's alleged role in a recent incident at RAF Fairford. Iranian officials rebuffed these claims, suggesting they shifted focus from British military operations against Iran, particularly the US usage of UK bases. Meanwhile, five British men were initially detained over a suspected terror plot but were ultimately released.

Lacking formal schooling, he understood how education could help alleviate poverty. He began his journey by saving profits from orange sales, ultimately earning national acclaim as a recipient of the Padma Shri award. His story serves as a powerful testament to how individual determination can uplift an entire community.

title: Unimaginable grief: 8 Pune students on school picnic drown at Diveagar beach
description: A picnic at Diveagar beach turned tragic when eight students from Pune drowned after being swept away. They misjudged the sea's depth and current strength, leading to their distress. Local authorities and rescue teams responded promptly to recover all eight bodies. Maharashtra ministers expressed their condolences and sought details regarding the incident. Legal and administrative procedures are currently being conducted at the site of the tragedy.

title: 'Smiling & laughing': India's envoy to UAE meets flydubai hero pilot Smit Machchhar

Passengers and two other pilots helped to restrain the attacker and safely landed the flight.

description: Originally founded by John Barefoot and expanded by Daniel Jenifer, Haberdeventure estate is steeped in history. Thomas Stone bought the estate in 1770, preserving it within his family for 166 years. A significant fire in 1977 led to protective actions and, in 1978, it became the Thomas Stone National Historic Site. Following restorations completed in 1997, it now spans 328 acres, serving as a historical hub for inquisitive visitors.

Australian scientists used wheat scent to confuse mice, cutting seed loss by 74%
description: Australian scientists tested a non-toxic way to protect wheat seeds from mice by spraying diluted wheat germ oil across farm plots. The treatment camouflaged the smell mice use to locate seeds underground. In a 2021 field experiment in New South Wales, seed loss fell by 63 per cent during and after sowing, and by up to 74 per cent when plots were treated before planting.

description: Google has unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, its most powerful AI model yet, topping 13 of 18 benchmarks against OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5. The model targets coding, legal, finance and cybersecurity work, with a 1 million token output limit. It is rolling out first to cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program, with paid API users and Google AI Ultra subscribers next in line.
